archivedDraft.scene: Sam, who avoids dairy, checks a breakfast order and finds the drink was made with regular milk.

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: A male server is mesero; in Spain you will hear camarero.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Do you have a table for one?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 一人ですが、テーブル席はありますか？
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Do you have a table for one?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Quisiera un café americano, por favor.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Quisiera is softer and more polite than quiero.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: アメリカーノをお願いします。
乳製品は口にできません。

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Excuse me, I ordered oat milk.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: A calm, polite way to point out a mix-up.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: すみません、オーツミルクを頼んだのですが。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Excuse me, I ordered oat milk.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Could you bring me the bill, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 伝票を持ってきていただけますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Could you bring me the bill, please?

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: カードで支払えますか？

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Primero, entré al café y le pregunté a la mesera: Buenos días, ¿tiene una mesa para uno?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: First, I walked into the café and asked the waitress: Good morning, do you have a table for one?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: まず、カフェに入って、ウェイトレスに尋ねました。「おはようございます。一人ですが、テーブル席はありますか？」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: First, I walked into the café and asked the waitress: Good morning, do you have a table for one?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ella me dio una mesa cerca del mostrador.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: She gave me a table near the counter.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 彼女は私をカウンターの近くのテーブルに案内してくれました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: She gave me a table near the counter.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luego pedí un café americano, huevos revueltos y pan tostado.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Then I ordered an americano, scrambled eggs and toast.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: それから、アメリカーノ、スクランブルエッグ、トーストを注文しました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Then I ordered an americano, scrambled eggs and toast.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: También le dije: No puedo tomar lácteos, ¿tienen leche de avena?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I also told her: I can't have dairy, do you have oat milk?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: また、彼女にこう伝えました。「乳製品は口にできません。オーツミルクはありますか？」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I also told her: I can't have dairy, do you have oat milk?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Cuando llegó el café, tenía leche normal, y le dije: Disculpe, pedí leche de avena.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: When the coffee arrived, it had regular milk, and I told her: Excuse me, I ordered oat milk.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: コーヒーが届いたとき、普通のミルクが入っていたので、「すみません、オーツミルクを頼んだのですが」と伝えました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: When the coffee arrived, it had regular milk, and I told her: Excuse me, I ordered oat milk.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: La mesera me cambió el café y me preguntó: ¿Es su primera vez en la ciudad?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The waitress changed my coffee and asked me: Is this your first time in the city?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ウェイトレスはコーヒーを取り替えてくれて、「この街は初めてですか？」と尋ねました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The waitress changed my coffee and asked me: Is this your first time in the city?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le contesté: Sí, y después voy a visitar el museo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I answered: Yes, and afterward I'm going to visit the museum.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 「はい。このあとミュージアムを訪れます」と答えました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I answered: Yes, and afterward I'm going to visit the museum.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Al final pedí la cuenta y pagué con tarjeta.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: At the end I asked for the bill and paid by card.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 最後に伝票をお願いし、カードで支払いました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: At the end I asked for the bill and paid by card.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Antes de salir, dejé una propina para la mesera.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Before leaving, I left a tip for the waitress.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 店を出る前に、ウェイトレスにチップを残しました。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Before leaving, I left a tip for the waitress.

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: Handle a table, order, dairy restriction, corrected coffee, small talk, bill and tip in one scene.
speakingGoalInternal: Handle a routine café breakfast from greeting to payment, including one small mix-up, without English.
sourceConflictInternal: The current source is a first-person, nine-turn café account: table near counter, americano, eggs and toast, dairy restriction, a regular-milk mistake replaced with coffee, museum plan, card payment and tip. The archived Sam scene drops most of these details and ends with a toast-only bill. The source setting is unspecified; do not import a Japan-specific tipping or restaurant rule. Qualified source, Japanese, dairy and locale review remains open.
